permission_dictionary.view_dashboards: Can view read-only telemetry and evaluation dashboards
permission_dictionary.trigger_finetuning: Can initiate, abort, and modify LoRA PEFT training jobs
permission_dictionary.modify_embeddings: Can alter the vectorization schema and embedding models
permission_dictionary.access_raw_datasets: Can download and view raw code/docs extraction JSONL files
permission_dictionary.approve_actionable_prs: Can ship auto-generated PRs directly to GitHub via the Actionable UI
permission_dictionary.override_drift_severity: Can manually adjust the severity of a detected drift event
